Subject: Onsite guest logistics: shuttle pick-up, badge handoff, and secure ID handling

Hi Elena / Tom —

Following up on the workshop logistics for July 27–28 at NovaPower HQ. I want to confirm the plan for visitor arrival, temporary badge issuance, and how we handle ID custody for the small contingent of contractors joining. Key asks below so operations and security have an actionable checklist: 

- Arrival window: 08:30–09:30 on Tue 7/27 (two shuttle waves)
- Shuttle pickup location: Hotel Meridian lobby (flagged desk A). Shuttle company: BlueLine Transit (contact: Jorge Ramos, 415-555-0230).
- Badge handoff: We will stage a temporary-issue table at the delivery / loading dock entrance. NovaPower security to authorize on-site badge printing & escorting to Conference Center room B2.
- ID custody: For contractor badges (HighShore consultants), NovaPower policy requires short-term custody of government IDs. We propose: secure chain-of-custody envelope (signed by our on-site liaison) and return at end of day. If this is not acceptable, please advise alternate options (ID scanning + secure deletion policy).
- Parking & drop-off: BlueLine will load/unload at Dock 3 only; please confirm dock access window.
- Emergency contacts: On-site Redwood liaison = Laura Bennett (415-555-0199).

Attached: preliminary visitor_manifest.csv (names, roles, flight info), draft shuttle_itinerary.pdf.

Can you confirm NovaPower security is OK with the above and whether we need to route IDs to the main security desk or an escorted holding box? Also flag any foreign-national screening requirements we must complete in advance.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onsite guest logistics: shuttle pick-up, badge handoff, and secure ID handling

Markus —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few notes from NovaPower security: 

- Dock 3 is available for both shuttle drop-off waves between 08:15–09:45; please have BlueLine check in with the gate guard on arrival.
- We do allow temporary badge printing at the delivery desk with prior authorization. Please have a signed visitor manifest and a copy of each attendee's government ID (we prefer scanned PDFs submitted ahead-of-time).
- For contractors: we do collect physical IDs into a locked evidence envelope at the main security desk (not the loading dock). The envelope is logged and returned to the assigned liaison at end of day. If Redwood wants the liaison to hold custody, we must have a signed waiver (I can share our standard form).
- Foreign nationals: two of your attendees flagged non-US passports. We need passport copies + full legal names at least 48 hours before arrival for a quick pre-clear.
- Vehicle access: BlueLine needs to be on an approved vendor list. Jorge Ramos (BlueLine) is not yet on file — please have Laura share his insurance and driver license number so I can onboard him as a temporary vendor.

I'll upload the security waiver and pre-clear checklist to the shared Drive link and add comments to the manifest.

Best — Elena

Elena Park
Director, Facilities & Security Operations | NovaPower

Elena —

I've coordinated with BlueLine and attached their vendor packet and the updated shuttle_itinerary.pdf (they confirmed both waves). Per your note, I've requested Jorge Ramos' driver license and insurance and uploaded to the Drive link (see related_links).

Per the ID handling: Redwood will follow NovaPower's standard locked-envelope flow at the main security desk. Marcus will be the on-site liaison responsible for signing the custody log at both drop-off and return. Marcus — can you confirm you'll handle the log and meet security at 08:10 on 7/27?

I'm also sending a sanitized visitor_manifest.csv with passport last-four redacted to avoid storing PII in our email thread. Full passport scans will be placed on the shared Drive with access limited to Elena, Laura, and our security lead.

Attachments: BlueLine_vendor_packet.pdf, shuttle_itinerary.pdf, visitor_manifest.csv (sanitized).

Thanks — Laura

Marcus —

Forwarding Elena's confirmation and Laura's vendor packet. Please meet NovaPower security at the main desk at 08:10 on 7/27 to sign the custody envelope and log. Process checklist below (copy this at the desk):

1) Check guest names against signed manifest (Drive link).
2) Hand over passport scans to NovaPower security via shared Drive link (do not email).
3) Sign custody log for any physical IDs placed into the locked envelope; keep a timestamped photo of the signed log for Redwood records.
4) Escort guests from main desk to Conference Center room B2 — do not allow unsupervised access to secure lab floors.
5) At end of day, retrieve IDs and confirm signature on return; upload a single custody_receipt.pdf to the shared Drive.

If anything changes with BlueLine timing, alert Elena and me immediately.

Thanks and appreciate the coverage — Markus
